session.summary: The user is planning to start a small vegetable garden and requests assistance with research, organization, and specific resources for beginners.

records.title: Beginner Vegetable Garden Project Plan
records.content: This record outlines the initial plan for starting a small vegetable garden in the backyard, including layout, supplies, and considerations for a beginner.
records.description: A project plan for starting a beginner vegetable garden with detailed sections on layout and supplies.

sections.heading: Garden Layout
sections.content: Planning a small garden bed of 4 feet by 8 feet, which is considered a good size for beginners. The chosen location receives about 6 hours of sunlight daily, and the user needs to verify if this is sufficient for most vegetables.

sections.heading: Supplies Needed
sections.content: List of necessary supplies includes soil, containers or raised bed materials, seeds, basic gardening tools, and a potential simple drip irrigation system for watering.

sections.heading: Additional Considerations
sections.content: Concerns include pest management, especially rabbits, with a preference for natural deterrents over chemicals. The user also mentions companion planting (e.g., basil near tomatoes) and aims to have everything planted by early May to avoid feeling overwhelmed.
